overview: Catalan/binary trees, substrings, assignments with constraints, subset tuples.
coreConcept: Counting = multiplication/addition principle + bijection with known objects.
hinglishExplanation: Rooted binary trees with n nodes = Catalan number, same as ways of parenthesizing. Subset tuples (A,B) with A subset of B: 3^n (each element in A, B-A, or outside B).
formalDefinition: Counting = multiplication/addition principle + bijection with known objects.
importantProperties: Substrings of length-n string: n(n+1)/2 + 1 (with empty).
